detail.longDescription: A few years ago, my husband and I adopted two kittens. Before they arrived home, I frantically researched everything I could about keeping cats alive because I knew nothing. Eventually, I found myself begging a coworker to help me web scrape a non-searchable site that listed everything toxic to animals.
